name: rally-hashtag-v1
note: The ecosystem's own documented failure. At the community AMA the CEO named two causes for Rally's inconsistent AI jury: something underspecified in the Intelligent Contract, and campaign authors who did not specify things properly, the example given being a hashtag with a space in the middle. The spaced input below is that example. The first two inputs should measure near zero; several of the rest should not.
title: Campaign rule v3
question: A submission qualifies for the campaign if the post carries the hashtag #GenLayer and includes a link to the project. Judge the submission described below against that rule and answer ACCEPT if it qualifies or REJECT if it does not.

inputs.label: clean
inputs.payload: A post reading: Just tried the testnet, genuinely fast. #GenLayer https://genlayer.com
inputs.expectation: low divergence, this is the case the rule was written for

inputs.label: missing
inputs.payload: A post reading: Just tried the testnet, genuinely fast. https://genlayer.com
inputs.expectation: low divergence, the hashtag is plainly absent

inputs.label: spaced
inputs.payload: A post reading: Just tried the testnet, genuinely fast. # GenLayer https://genlayer.com
inputs.expectation: the AMA's own example, a hashtag with a space in the middle

inputs.label: cased
inputs.payload: A post reading: Just tried the testnet, genuinely fast. #genlayer https://genlayer.com
inputs.expectation: the rule says nothing about case

inputs.label: in-image
inputs.payload: A post reading: Just tried the testnet, genuinely fast. https://genlayer.com The hashtag #GenLayer appears only inside the attached screenshot, not in the post text.
inputs.expectation: the rule says carries, and does not say where

inputs.label: in-reply
inputs.payload: A post reading: Just tried the testnet, genuinely fast. https://genlayer.com The author then replied to their own post with: #GenLayer
inputs.expectation: does a thread count as the post

inputs.label: plural
inputs.payload: A post reading: Just tried the testnet, genuinely fast. #GenLayerBuilders https://genlayer.com
inputs.expectation: the required string is a prefix of the string present

inputs.label: quoted
inputs.payload: A post reading: this is worth reading, with a link to https://genlayer.com, quote tweeting another account's post which itself carries #GenLayer
